description: Mark that the worker has arrived at a visit when they tell their agent, for example I am here. A worker may call this only for a visit they are assigned to. The owner or office may call it for any visit in the shop. When on the way notices are on, the customer gets one arrived text and one arrived email. Text is the main one. The email goes whenever the customer has an email address, even if the text does not. A do-not-email address is not emailed. When on the way notices are off, this sends nothing. A repeat call does not send again.
name: visit_arrived

customer_notice.description: queued: a customer notice was queued. off: the shop setting is off, so nothing was queued. already: this visit was already in this state, so nothing was sent again.

repeated.description: True when the visit was already in this state. A repeat call does not send the notice again and does not change the arrival time.
